summary: The session explores the evolving role of AI in society, emphasizing the need for higher ambitions beyond mere productivity. It discusses the importance of ontologies, multi-agent systems, and the integration of AI with quantum technologies to address complex global challenges. The speaker encourages leveraging AI to improve quality of life and foster innovation rather than simply automating existing tasks.

key_points: AI is a real presence that requires us to push our boundaries.
We are at the beginning of an economic s-curve.
We need to create order from randomness through platforms and operating models.
The importance of ontologies in controlling data usage.

sections.topic: AI in Healthcare and Quality of Life
key_points: AI can improve healthcare outcomes and work-life balance.
The Young Blood experiment illustrates potential for longevity.
Multi-agent systems can enhance diagnostic accuracy.
Quantum technologies will play a crucial role in future AI applications.
We must leverage AI to make life better for people.
Productivity alone is not enough; we need to foster greater ambitions.

key_takeaways: AI should be used to improve quality of life, not just for productivity.
Ontologies and multi-agent systems are essential for effective AI deployment.
Quantum technologies will significantly enhance AI capabilities in the near future.
